title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Join our engineering team for a 6-month internship. You will work on backend services, write unit tests, participate in code reviews, and contribute to production features under the guidance of senior engineers. This is a paid internship with potential for a full-time offer.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Work alongside our data science team building ML models for customer insights. Responsibilities include data cleaning, EDA, model training, and presenting findings. Experience with Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Jupyter is expected. Strong communication skills required.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
description: Build and maintain user interfaces for our cloud management platform. Collaborate with designers and backend engineers. Write clean, accessible, and testable React code. This is a full-time entry-level position.

title: Business Analyst Intern
description: Assist the analytics team with data gathering, requirement documentation, and dashboard creation. Understand financial datasets and support senior analysts in preparing client reports. Good Excel and SQL skills are essential.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Help maintain CI/CD pipelines, monitor system health, write infrastructure-as-code scripts, and support the platform engineering team. Ideal for students interested in cloud infrastructure and automation.
